text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can produce art, music, and writing that look and sound surprisingly human. You can ask a computer to paint a picture or write a short story, and it will do it in seconds. However, there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. Humans create from emotion, experience, and imagination. AI simply learns patterns from existing data. So while AI can copy styles and generate new ideas, it cannot truly feel or understand what it makes. In the end, AI is a powerful tool, but human creativity remains unique.
